title: [CDCSDK] Producer failure "COMMIT record without preceding BEGIN" encountered on connector resume
body:
Jira Link: [DB-16270](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-16270)
### Description

In the test `test_cdc_support_multi_schema_versions`, we deploy two connectors on the same table using different stream IDs. Connector 2 is configured with a 60s cdc.poll.interval.ms, and is paused after partial replication.
Upon resuming connector 2, it crashes with the following error:
```
2025-04-16 16:45:56,013 ERROR  YugabyteDB|yb_connector_2|streaming|0  Producer failure   [io.debezium.pipeline.ErrorHandler]
io.debezium.DebeziumException: COMMIT record encountered without a preceding BEGIN record
	at io.debezium.connector.yugabytedb.YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.getChanges2(YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.java:650)
	at io.debezium.connector.yugabytedb.YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.execute(YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.java:158)
	at io.debezium.connector.yugabytedb.YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.execute(YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.java:49)
	at io.debezium.connector.yugabytedb.YugabyteDBChangeEventSourceCoordinator.streamEvents(YugabyteDBChangeEventSourceCoordinator.java:167)
	at io.debezium.connector.yugabytedb.YugabyteDBChangeEventSourceCoordinator.executeChangeEventSources(YugabyteDBChangeEventSourceCoordinator.java:153)
	at io.debezium.pipeline.ChangeEventSourceCoordinator.lambda$start$0(ChangeEventSourceCoordinator.java:109)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.Executors$RunnableAdapter.call(Executors.java:515)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.FutureTask.run(FutureTask.java:264)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor.runWorker(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:1128)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor$Worker.run(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:628)
	at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:829)
2025-04-16 16:45:56,014 INFO   YugabyteDB|yb_connector_2|streaming|0  Received throwable to check for retry: {}   [io.debezium.connector.yugabytedb.YugabyteDBErrorHandler]
io.debezium.DebeziumException: COMMIT record encountered without a preceding BEGIN record
	at io.debezium.connector.yugabytedb.YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.getChanges2(YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.java:650)
	at io.debezium.connector.yugabytedb.YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.execute(YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.java:158)
	at io.debezium.connector.yugabytedb.YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.execute(YugabyteDBStreamingChangeEventSource.java:49)
	at io.debezium.connector.yugabytedb.YugabyteDBChangeEventSourceCoordinator.streamEvents(YugabyteDBChangeEventSourceCoordinator.java:167)
	at io.debezium.connector.yugabytedb.YugabyteDBChangeEventSourceCoordinator.executeChangeEventSources(YugabyteDBChangeEventSourceCoordinator.java:153)
	at io.debezium.pipeline.ChangeEventSourceCoordinator.lambda$start$0(ChangeEventSourceCoordinator.java:109)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.Executors$RunnableAdapter.call(Executors.java:515)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.FutureTask.run(FutureTask.java:264)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor.runWorker(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:1128)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor$Worker.run(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:628)
	at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:829)
```

quay.io/yugabyte/debezium-connector:dz.1.9.5.yb.grpc.2024.2.2
